senses.definition_en: a popular term among young people and the LGBT community on TikTok to refer to a group that creates and consumes memes from “Potaxie lore”, a humorous universe featuring characters, kingdoms, and conflicts used as a form of entertainment and collective identity, sometimes as a response to sexist and homophobic attitudes.
glosses: a popular term among young people and the LGBT community on TikTok to refer to a group that creates and consumes memes from “Potaxie lore”, a humorous universe featuring characters, kingdoms, and conflicts used as a form of entertainment and collective identity, sometimes as a response to sexist and homophobic attitudes.

senses.definition_en: a member of the Potaxie community; someone with feminist, anti-sexist and anti-homophobic views

examples.english: On the other hand, “potaxie” refers to people who identify with the LGBTQI+ community and follow a fictional icon named Jiafei. This character is an AI-generated creation that combines traits of two Chinese singers: Meng Jia and Wang FeiFei. The term originated from a viral video that repeatedly mentions the potassium content of avocados, which serve as a symbol for this group. “Potaxies” adopt an open and progressive stance.
examples.ref: 2024 July 8, “Una divulgadora lingüística te explica cuáles son los términos que están más de moda en internet”, in El Confidencial, Madrid, archived from the original on 14 Jul 2024:
examples.text: Por otro lado, potaxie describe a personas identificadas con la comunidad LGTBIQ+ que siguen a un ícono ficticio llamado Jiafei. Este personaje es una creación de inteligencia artificial que combina características de dos cantantes chinas: Meng Jia y Wang FeiFei. El origen de la palabra está en un video viral que menciona repetidamente el contenido de potasio del aguacate, símbolo de este grupo. Los potaxies adoptan una postura abierta y progresista.
examples.translation: On the other hand, “potaxie” refers to people who identify with the LGBTQI+ community and follow a fictional icon named Jiafei. This character is an AI-generated creation that combines traits of two Chinese singers: Meng Jia and Wang FeiFei. The term originated from a viral video that repeatedly mentions the potassium content of avocados, which serve as a symbol for this group. “Potaxies” adopt an open and progressive stance.

glosses: a member of the Potaxie community; someone with feminist, anti-sexist and anti-homophobic views
